svg.title: ThingsBoard release-3.6 - service startup and shutdown

g.text: Context refresh: dependency graph, not a global total order
Each selected singleton has its own partial order:
The container invokes creations one at a time by its dependency graph,
but unrelated beans have no mutual order contract.
Independent bean-local examples (list order is not execution order):
Protocol ports may be open before ApplicationReadyEvent.
[order 10 listeners; one callback at a time, peer order unspecified]
Core/rule consumers, transport API and update checks are examples.
Their callbacks are serial; submitted workers may overlap later callbacks.
asynchronous poll/work may already be running
runtime: poll, callback, commit, scheduled work
No project ContextClosedEvent listener or SmartLifecycle phase.
Peer beans without dependency edges have no documented total order.
[eligible singletons; one destroy callback at a time, peer order unspecified]
close cache; close client; shutdownNow ZK executor
Ephemeral-session removal is fallback when explicit delete fails
or the session is already lost.
Peer ZK watchers observe node removal later and trigger recalculation;
this is not a direct destroy-to-partition call.
stop managers; await each task up to 30s
shutdown dispatchers; await each up to 3s
shutdownNow is not completion. An effect committed before an
offset commit may be replayed; an open JDBC call may outlive interruption.
